raw_response_capture.exact_point: immediately after HttpProvider.post_stream returns and before AnthropicAdapter._aggregate_stream or body content projection
raw_response_capture.stream_shape_source: content_block_start/message_delta headers plus delta lengths only

raw_response_capture.exact_point: immediately after HttpProvider.post_stream returns and before OpenAIChatAdapter._aggregate_stream or first choice/message projection
raw_response_capture.stream_shape_source: choice delta structural keys and lengths only

raw_response_capture.exact_point: immediately after HttpProvider.post_stream returns and before OpenAIResponsesAdapter._aggregate_stream, _output_text, or output projection
raw_response_capture.stream_shape_source: response event kinds, item/content kinds, and delta lengths only

raw_shape_builder.responsibility: protocol-aware one-pass extraction of enums, counts, length metadata, completeness, and a metadata-only shape digest

raw_capture_transport.responsibility: ModelGateway opens/resets a per-attempt slot; the adapter deposits one immutable metadata-only snapshot before normalization; ModelGateway emits it with the canonical correlation after adapter return or while re-raising the exact adapter exception

normalized_shape_observer.exact_point: after adapter return and ProviderOutputShapeV1 projection, before guard evaluation

guard_decision_observer.exact_point: evaluate and snapshot the existing predicate inputs once, immediately before the existing predicate branch; do not replace or broaden that branch

recovery_disposition.responsibility: record whether an existing alternate route was considered/selected or typed fail-close was selected

trace_persistence.failure_behavior: returns false and never raises into business code

canary_call_locator.design: bind the existing BoundaryRequest.ordinal into the active ModelDiagnosticContext through an execution-local ContextVar; it is an optional locator under the canonical inner_attempt_id, not a new identity

call_order: CanaryGateway._dispatch_open assigns the existing external boundary ordinal when Canary instrumentation is present
ModelGateway opens an execution-local metadata capture slot, then Provider adapter invokes HttpProvider.post_stream
observer point A deposits raw transport/body shape metadata into that slot before aggregation or projection; it does not mutate ModelResponse
adapter performs protocol-specific aggregation and constructs ModelResponse
ModelGateway emits the captured A receipt under the canonical correlation, then observer point B projects ProviderOutputShapeV1 and creates RawToNormalizedShapeDeltaV1
observer point C snapshots current PTR9 scope and predicate inputs, then observes the unchanged predicate decision
on trigger, existing negative-capability write occurs and its result is observed
strict-tool extraction, parser/schema conversion, and domain validation continue unchanged
Contract Runtime emits the recovery disposition and updates its existing local output_limit_seen classification
terminal exception, if any, is correlated by the same inner_attempt_id and existing boundary locator
ModelGateway resets the capture slot in finally
